text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Kris S!! Symboli Kris S crosses 
the finish line in majestic fashion!!
(Uwooooooooahhh—!!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haah...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Why... am I losing...?!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaah!!

She roared in frustration toward the 
heavens. Vast, fierce, and boundless.

It seemed to have reached her ears without 
fail—even amidst the massive cheers 
celebrating her victory.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Ah... Kris S-san.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...I don't know.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I don't know... and I'm a little scared 
to find out—)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, ...we need to get ready for the 
concert, don't we?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-Thank you for your hard work—
(Grab...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Looking over, ...my arm was being 
grabbed.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(No, it could hardly be called grabbing. 
Because the strength in that hand was so 
terribly weak, almost... almost like a 
baby's.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Kris S-san...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ――...Rob Roy. ――Zenno Rob Roy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Kris S-san's eyes waver.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Faintly. Yet undeniably, ――it sways.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Are you searching for words?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Are you searching... thinking about me? 
...About who I am?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, I'd be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If that were true, I'd be... so very 
happy.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Honestly, I don't know if I ever managed 
to become a lingering regret to them.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Even a while after the 'Arima Kinen' 
ended, Kris S-san didn't retract her 
retirement.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(And yet, no matter what, it's already 
over.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(Our first and last Arima Kinen... has now 
come to an end.)

The day after the Arima Kinen, Zenno Rob 
Roy properly showed up for our meeting.

Her eyes looked just a tiny bit swollen 
from crying, but... I decided not to point 
it out.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. For the next goal... would the 
Tenno Sho (Spring) be okay?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I want to aim for it. The glorious Spring 
Shield. And then—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I want to make a name for myself, even 
more. ...I want to become a hero that 
everyone acknowledges.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because... ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
What if... what if. What if that person 
were to return—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
On as grand a stage as possible. I want to 
welcome you as my finest self, after all.
choice_data_list:
...Yeah. Let's aim for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) next.

...Yeah. Let's aim for the Tenno Sho 
(Spring) next.

text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy doesn't stop walking. She 
simply carries one more precious thing on 
her shoulders as she continues forward.
